summary: Workspace CI runs the canonical hosted graph on every main push, including all four Rust test shards. Main upkeep waits for the exact push attempt's linux-test-build, linux-clippy and linux-fleet-compat results instead of requiring a nonexistent merge-group run or projecting duplicate jobs. Advisory outcomes remain visible in Workspace CI. Claim-page index-plan assertions now require the upper-bound seek added by bounded history reads.

replay.detail: CI routing and query-plan regression coverage only; no claims or projections change.

compatibility.detail: PR and merge-group support remains; direct main pushes receive canonical hosted proof without borrowing queue results. The three required fast-lane checks are unchanged.
